info.title: nuget-to-complog
info.description: Extract a portable CompLog (compilation log) from a NuGet package, or eject and patch the original source. The .NET equivalent of patch-package.

options.name: --patches-dir
options.description: Base directory for patches. Defaults to ./patches/ [Default: null]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Create a patch from changes made to an ejected package.

options.name: --patches-dir
options.description: Base directory for patches. Defaults to ./patches/ [Default: null]

commands.name: eject
commands.description: Eject a NuGet package into an editable source project.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for patches. Defaults to ./patches/ [Default: null]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Which assembly to eject when the package ships several for one target framework. Defaults to the one named after the package. [Default: null]

commands.name: swap
commands.description:
Swap a project's PackageReference for the package built from its recovered source:
ejects the package into an editable project with a generated .csproj and rewrites the
consuming project to use a ProjectReference instead.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the consuming project (.csproj) or its directory. Defaults to the single .csproj in the current directory. [Default: null]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the ejected project. Defaults to ./patches/ [Default: null]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Which assembly to eject when the package ships several for one target framework. Defaults to the one named after the package. [Default: null]

commands.name: verify
commands.description:
Verify a package round-trips: create a complog, rebuild from it with the exact compiler,
and byte-compare the result against the assembly shipped in the package.

options.name: --fetch-compiler
options.description: Download the exact compiler (Microsoft.Net.Compilers.Toolset) from nuget.org or the dnceng dotnet-tools feed when it is not installed locally.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Which assembly to verify when the package ships several for one target framework (e.g. nunit.framework.legacy.dll). Defaults to the one named after the package. [Default: null]

options.name: --skip-generators
options.description: Do not load or run source generator assemblies in this process. Their documents are then passed as plain source files, which cannot reproduce the original PDB exactly.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Which assembly to capture when the package ships several for one target framework (e.g. nunit.framework.dll). Defaults to the one named after the package. [Default: null]
